profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Dell Technologies
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with a focus in .NET, relational databases, system design, and OOP programming principles. I work with C#, IIS, microservices, REST, SOAP, software as a service (SaaS), PostgreSQL, and CI/CD integrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated our customer API to use a session-based authentication system and deprecated the previous process

Improved retrieval performance by 5x for endpoints that fetch vehicle history and diagnostics

Improved our regression testing framework by adding support for more complex system tests and by speeding up test execution times

Sped up the telematic REST API’s read performance by utilizing indexes and optimizing SQL queries

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and extended a process that imports daily hierarchy data for 10K vehicles and 1K users

Mentored summer interns, which included helping them with our code base, release process, and general C# and PostgreSQL information

While in New Zealand, developed in an app that aggregated vehicle maintenance reports and displayed them in a UI

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Created a C# program that analyzes code dependencies and detects circular dependencies for over 100 components

Implemented an automated process with bash and Python to e-mail daily customer reports

Wrote a PostgreSQL function to obfuscate sensitive data from fuel transactions

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
